question: Would the unchanged paper lane make the same gate and executed-action choices from fresh Helius market state when evaluated with the actual lane's position, cooldown, cap, and pre-decision history context?
oracle: PumpPortal remains the sole runtime decision input; Helius is a report-only same-instant counterfactual.

gateDecisionComparator.name: same_instant_helius_state_with_actual_lane_context
gateDecisionComparator.positionSemantics: An active position does not suppress a PAPER_SHADOWED gate pass; gate agreement measures WOULD_ENTER versus WOULD_SKIP, while executed-action agreement handles actual entry availability.
gateDecisionComparator.reason: V2 still used an independent stateful shadow paper lane for gate decisions. Its private positions suppressed 45 of 46 reported gate divergences, so the first V2 run was not a valid test of the frozen question.

supersedes.observedDefect: 45/46 gate divergences had shadowDecisionMissing=true because V2 gate comparison still depended on an independent stateful shadow paper lane.

walletRule.required: Every comparable gate evaluation carries explicit Portal-vs-Helius wallet feature and tracked-address accounting.

prohibitions: No Helius shadow state may feed runtime strategy decisions.
No live enablement, procurement switch, or gate loosening may follow from this experiment alone.
A state snapshot older than 1000 ms is non-comparable, never a mismatch.
V1 and V2 rows cannot count toward V3 evidence.
Comparator semantics and thresholds are frozen before the first V3 run.
nextIfPass: Repeat the report-only result on another eligible full-coverage session before proposing any procurement change.
nextIfFail: Autopsy fresh-state divergences without changing strategy gates or live settings.
